name: Somogyviszló (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow green horizontal stripe through the centre, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Somogyviszló (a shield of green and white with trefoils, a spade and a plough) below a yellow scroll inscribed SOMOGYVISZLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
